forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: This page is for administrators only. Projects and results remain available to you.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist (anymore). The project or analysis may have been deleted.

general.title: Something went wrong
general.text: Please reload the page. If the error persists, contact the administrators.

issues.title: The settings are incomplete
issues.unsaved: The settings have never been saved (defaults apply).
issues.unreadableText: The network drive password cannot be decrypted with the current app secret. Please enter it again in the settings.

worker.title: EPLAN worker
worker.restartQuestion: EPLAN is stopped and started again with the next job. A running analysis fails.

hint.disconnected: The EPLAN worker is not reachable
hint.text: Uploaded projects and selected analyses wait in the queue until the worker is connected again.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.toggle: Switch the schedule on or off
schedule.invalid: The cron expression or the time zone is invalid.
schedule.notActive: The schedule is switched on but not scheduled in this process (check the settings).
schedule.offHint: Switched off: projects in the project folder are only analyzed on request.

recent.title: Recently analyzed
recent.noneHint: Upload a project archive (.zw1) or choose projects from the project folder.

login.subtitle: Connections, cables, shields and texts from EPLAN projects
login.hint: Access is controlled by your company sign-in.

accessHint.read: View and evaluate projects, analyses and results. Nothing is changed.
accessHint.write: Also start analyses; administrators can also change the schedule and settings (without passwords).

connect.lifetime: A connection is valid for 30 days. After that, open {command} in Claude Code again and choose “Authenticate”.

errors.invalid_settings: Some settings are invalid. Please check the marked fields.
errors.settings_incomplete: The settings are incomplete. Please complete the settings first.
errors.secret_required: A stored password only applies to its previous share and user. After a change, please enter the password again.
errors.secret_unreadable: The stored network drive password can no longer be read. Please enter it again in the settings.
errors.analysis_already_queued: An analysis of this project is already waiting or running.
errors.analysis_running: The analysis is running. Please wait until it has finished.
errors.analysis_not_succeeded: This analysis has no results (it did not finish successfully).
errors.analysis_not_running: The analysis is no longer running.
errors.no_current_analysis: This project has not been analyzed successfully yet.
errors.project_or_analysis_required: Please specify a project or an analysis.
errors.project_or_folder_path_required: Please specify either a project id or a path in the project folder.
errors.folder_not_found: The project folder was not found.
errors.folder_unreadable: The project folder cannot be read.
errors.folder_project_not_found: The project was not found in the project folder.
errors.invalid_path: The path is invalid. Allowed are paths to .elk or .zw1 files relative to the project folder.
errors.edb_missing: The .edb folder with the same name as the .elk file is missing.
errors.network_drive_unsupported: Network drives are only supported on Windows.
errors.network_drive_failed: The network drive could not be connected.
errors.drive_unavailable: The network drive is not reachable after connecting.
errors.upload_invalid_type: Please upload a project archive in .zw1 format.
errors.upload_too_large: The file is too large (at most {maxMb} MB).
errors.upload_name_too_long: The project name is too long (at most {max} characters); please rename the file.
errors.worker_unreachable: The EPLAN worker is not reachable.
errors.log_dir_not_configured: Logs are only available in the Windows service (NUXT_LOG_DIR is missing).
